BeeBPMs_12212020.pdf.title: Honey Bee Best Management Practices for California Almonds: A Guide for Pollination Stakeholders
BeeBPMs_12212020.pdf.climate_context: California almond orchards (bloom in February, large-scale commercial hive rental)
BeeBPMs_12212020.pdf.document_version: 2018 revised copy, PDF dated 2020-12-21. Industry practice for California: hive numbers and strength are the local norm there, not a Turkish or Spanish recommendation, and it is not regulatory.
